spans.s: --son of Sudyu and father of सम्याति. Vi. IV. १९. 1.
--a son of Sudyu and father of सम्याति. भा. IX. २०. 3.
--a son of Dhundhu and father of सञ्जाति. वा. ९९. १२२.
--a तीर्थ on the नर्मदा, to be seen on the त्रयोदशी। M. १९१. १४.
--a प्रजापति, who married two daughters of दक्ष and had four sons. Br.
--a son of Citraka. Br. III. ७१. ११५; वा. ९६. ११४.

--a son of रिपुञ्जय;
1: भा. IX. २१. ३०.
with him ends the Paurava line.
2: Vi. IV. १९. ५५.
(I)--a son of मेधातिथि of शाकद्वीप. भा. V. २०. २५;
(II)--one of the eleven Rudras; son of भूत and सरूपा. भा.

--a king of Videha ruling from मिथिला; son of धृति and father of कृति; a devotee of कृष्ण; felt that the line of Nimi was purified by their stay. भा. IX. १३. २६; X. ८६. १६, २४-37; Br. III. ६४. २३; वा. ८९. २३; Vi.
--a son of Dhundhu and father of सम्पाति. M. ४९. 3.
--a kingdom to which Puramjana went by the entrance, Mukhya; allegorically food. भा. IV. २५. ४९; २९. १२.

(I)--a name given to the thirteen sons of the Kings of किलिकिला;
1: भा.

. ३४.
took part in the राजसूय of युधिष्- ठिर;
2: Ib. X. ७५. 6.
three of the thirteen sons were of the Nandana family; Ekalas or lords of small regions.
3: Vi. IV. २४. ५७. ५८.
--(Lekhas:?) पितृदेवस्; to them कृष्ण- पक्ष is day and शुक्लपक्ष is night. वा. ५६. ८७.
(I)--son of वृक; driven away from his kingdom; retired with his wife to the forest; gave birth to Sagara. भा.

(II)--a son of धृतक (वृक-वि। प्।); was attacked and deprived of his kingdom by the Haihayas and the तालजन्घस् with the help of the शकस्, Yavanas, काम्- bojas, पारदस्, and Palhavas, the five tribes; hence the king abdicated and took to a life of penance with his wife in the forest as an old man. Once he went to bring water when he slipped into the waters and died; his wife यादवी followed him though she was in the family way; she had been poisoned by her co-wife to prevent pregnancy; she got into the funeral pyre. Aurva, the भार्गव withdrew her from the fire; she was in his आश्रम and brought forth Sagara (Saha Gara). वा. ८८. १२१-33; Vi.
--married two daughters of दक्ष. M. १४६. १७; वा. ६३. ४२.
--R. in भारतवर्ष originally गौरी, wife of युवनाश्व; sacred to the पितृस्; rises in the हिमालयस्. Br. III. ६३. ६७; M. २२. ५५; ११४. २२; वा. ४५. ९६; ८८. ६६.
--a clan belonging to Rohita प्रजापति. वा. १००. ६१.
--a R. from the Sahya Mountains. Br. II. १६. ३५.
--a son of भजमान, married the two sisters who were the daughters of सृम्जय and brought forth a number of sons. वा. ९

(II)--(च्) a Northern Kingdom;
1: Br. II. १६. ४६; १८. ४६.
after the son of बाह्लीक.
2: M. ५०. ३९; ११४. ४०; १६३. ७२.
